text: Story room read whole against story-p3: canucks, told. Its pass 2 residue, spare accounts serving the attack on the Flames logo before the room had any work, is now in A06's sentence. The attack as the first canvas act, members turning the room to build its own logo, the GreenLattice border sought and contested (told as border talk), taunts and victory claims, and an apology after the close are told; the April Fools frame runs beside.

Story room read whole against story-p3: catalunya, told-with-residue. Calls, upkeep, truce and barter with neighbours, relocation help, restraint toward Factorio, a script to build at night, the celebration and the flag for posterity are told. Still untold: how the room came to host and whom it admitted (no drawings on the flag except r/Factorio, by agreement). The room also contradicts the story's sentence that the hosts on record are rooms the canvas founded: catalunya had readers before the canvas, and its ruling sits under border and barter themes, outside the vetting reading.

Story room read whole against story-p3: empiredidnothingwrong, told. Its pass 2 residue, spare accounts building the centre before any upkeep, is now in A06's sentence. The template with the first call, a clash settled by apology, allies against Italy repaid, Italy's apology and route-around, a work spared for maintenance, a role-play division of the work, and the close carried to the new canvas are told. Rule used here and kept for the pass: where membership carried in only gives the idiom in which the story's steps are told (here Star Wars lore), the room is told; where it picks the rival, the guest or the work, it is a residue.

Story room read whole against story-p3: greenlattice, told-with-residue. Its pass 2 opening residue is now told by the story's sentence on bodies the canvas gathers: founded at h3.79 with no readers before the canvas, it runs calls, building, keeping, treaties, help traded for space, alliances, restraint, a fall back, and the close carried to new canvases. Still untold: hosting, the territory run as a host that ruled on applications and consumed unapproved art, with members split over doctrine whether to host at all.

Story room read whole against story-p3: guatemala, told. Its pass 2 residue, the reason for the move written after it, is now told by the sentence from A10's pass 3 bound. The planned flag, the start time, the first pixel and call, the lost spot, a heart taken and the request to move, and the one surviving heart recorded are told.

Story room read whole against story-p3: orderofthebluecorner, told-with-residue. Founded by the canvas as a colour faction, now told by the story's opening; calls, the sign, attack calls reined in, the rainbow truce, defence and the retained corner are told. Still untold: hosting by colour (guests admitted only if completely blue) and the colour faith naming the rivals (purging heresy).

Story room read whole against story-p3: placeDE, told-with-residue. As a side sub opened for the canvas it is now told by the story's opening; Discord planning, night watch and cleaning, agreements kept, help to Spain, Ireland, Italy and Belgium, attacks and provocations refused, and the close carried to Place 2.0 are told. Still untold: hosting by fit with the nation (logos not tied to Germany refused) and the national membership setting what the flag shows.

Story room read whole against story-p3: rainbowgrid, told. Its pass 2 residue, a room formed after the work to speak for it, is now told by the story's opening sentence on makers who form a room. Calls to resurrect the alien, a heart added, a peace offer to Erase the Place rejected, the argument over erasure, the call to save the grid and the attackers' taunts are told.

Story room read whole against story-p3: scp, told-with-residue. Proposal, blueprint and calls, doubt, a move after the loss, a second design in Discord, the lettering defaced by one person with alts, and the mourned close are told; the April Fools tale runs beside. Still untold, as declared: the fear that the mark would bring rule-breaking newcomers to the wiki.

Story room read whole against story-p3: starcitizen, told-with-residue. Its pass 2 policing residue is now told by A20 (members object to the flood, the moderators make one official thread with terms and later limit canvas posts). Calls with no start, Elite's offer of space, help repaid and the space alliance, scripts argued, the Hornet approved by Rainbow Road and left half done, and the close are told. Still untold: the rivalry with Elite carried in from before the canvas, which made some members call the alliance surrender.

Story room read whole against story-p3: sweden, told-with-residue. Its pass 2 policing residue is now told by A20 (the sticky, r/SwedenOnPlace and AutoModerator referrals). Calls, the night watch, truces and alliances, help traded, attack calls and refusals, scripts, taunts and the close are told. Still untold: hosting (dozens of guests admitted by request, Discord vote and ties) and the national history carried in that picked Denmark as the rival. One forest page exceeded the output limit and was saved where it cannot be read; it was read again in two smaller pages.

Story room read whole against story-p3: texans, told-with-residue. Its pass 2 carrying-on residue (flair asked for while the logo was kept) is now told by A09's sentence. Calls, a stickied blueprint, moves away from stronger neighbours, defence, a treaty with r/placehearts repaid with a heart, restraint, a late script and the close are told; the anime takeover runs beside. Still untold: the league rivalry carried in made a second mark, FTC, a taunt built in pixels.

Story room read whole against story-p3: texas, told. Its pass 2 policing residue is now told by A20 (r/placeTexas opened so canvas posts stop flooding r/texas, and a moderator removes later ones). Its national history residue is told under the idiom rule: the Alamo, San Jacinto and come and take it give the idiom of the fight, but the rival is a neighbour whose flag grew into Texas's spot. Calls, help, the Kolache and Crusader Kings deals, refused attack calls, scripts, the move and the taunts after the close are told. The second forest page was read once before the compaction reconciliation line and again after it.

Story room read whole against story-p3: totallynotrobots, told-with-residue. Calls, a template and coordinates, a scoreboard spared by agreement, scripts argued, a late move beside the fox with an apology to r/foxes, the unfinished close and PlaceTwo are told. Still untold: the sub's own joke picked the one work, a CAPTCHA to prove the members human, and set members against scripts. Under the idiom rule that is membership carried in that picks the work.

Story room read whole against story-p3: unitedkingdom, told-with-residue. Its pass 2 policing residue is now told by A20 (the sticky, requests to ban canvas posts, removals, r/placeuk and a coordinating sub). Calls, design argument, defence, truces with the Red Wings and Italy, help to and from France, Wales and Mexico, the FlagAlliance, refused raids, scripts, banter and the close are told. Still untold: national history and the union's politics picked the rivals (Argentina by the Falklands, Germany by the world wars, the EU flag by Brexit, the Scottish flag) and set which symbols belong on the work.

Story room read whole against story-p3: completeanarchy, told-with-residue. Calls, defence, the left coalition through r/TheFarLeftSide, bots, a move and a rebuild, taunts, the celebrated Free Territory and the copy of the game are told. Still untold: the ideology carried in picked the rivals (ancaps, fascists, 4chan, tankies) and the works (BASH THE FASH, the left flags), and the raids on rival flags were carried out and celebrated. Its most-placed fourth-order theme, Frame bridging, is outside the model.

Story room read whole against story-p3: CKCrusaders, told-with-residue. Its opening is told by the sentence on side subs a readership opens for its canvas work (no posts in the week before; members sent back to r/CrusaderKings). Calls, design settled in Discord, defence, borders with allies, pacts with Sweden and r/eu4, help with Texas, calls answered inside the room, the close and friendships kept are told. Still untold: the crusade lore carried in picked which neighbour to attack, the Turkish flag to recapture Constantinople, after the day9 plan was called off.

Story room read whole against story-p3: placecanada, told. A side sub Canadian readers opened for the canvas, told by the story's opening sentence. Official strategy and a template, off-template placers messaged, defence, scripts argued, the Quebec border argued, the 1G pact, help given to other rooms, alliances, refused attacks, the fight with Quebec argued as history after the close, and the record are told. Quebec was picked by the canvas, not by history: its flag sat where the Canadian flag grew, and the separatist jokes give only the idiom. The national emblems are the topic's own picture.

Story room read whole against story-p3: OKState, told. A late room with one thread: a call with a pattern, one-line answers, a small design argument, a bot to match the Spock bot, a move from a spot r/startrek scripted, and the script going up as placement ended, with their small place claimed. Every step is in the story.
